about.title: Personal Injury Help in Cypress, California
about.longDescription: Cypress is a quiet community, but its roads still see their share of collisions. In the most recent full year on record, the city logged 145 injury collisions, with 197 people hurt and 1 traffic death. Crashes here tend to cluster around Wednesday afternoons between 2 and 4 p.m., and the corridors with the highest recorded collision counts include Valley View Street, Walker Street, Ball Road, and Lincoln Avenue — streets many Cypress residents drive daily on the way to work, school, or the shops along these routes. If you or someone you love was hurt in one of these incidents, sorting out medical bills, insurance calls, and missed work can feel overwhelming on top of physical recovery. LawProactive is a free service — not a law firm — that connects injured people in Cypress with an independent personal injury attorney who can review the details of what happened. There's no cost to get connected, and attorneys in the network only get paid if you recover compensation. You don't have to figure out next steps on your own; a short conversation can help clarify your options while the details are still fresh.

whyChoose.title: Why Cypress Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: You Have Time, But Not Forever
items.desc: California generally gives you two years from the date of an injury to file a claim, though claims against a government agency can require notice in as little as six months. Getting connected early helps preserve evidence while memories and records are still fresh.

items.title: Partial Fault Won't Shut You Out
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you were partly responsible for what happened. Your compensation is simply adjusted to reflect your share of fault, not eliminated.

items.title: No Cap on What You've Suffered
items.desc: In ordinary injury cases, California places no limit on non-economic damages like pain and suffering. An attorney can help evaluate the full scope of what you've been through, not just medical bills.

items.title: No Fee Unless You Recover
items.desc: Attorneys in the LawProactive network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you receive a settlement or award. There's no upfront cost to have your situation reviewed.

items: Worrying about who will pay for medical bills and treatment

items.question: How much does it cost to get connected through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and attorneys in the network work on contingency, meaning they only collect a fee if you recover compensation. There's no upfront cost or obligation to move forward.

items.question: Is LawProactive a law firm?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free connection service that helps injured people in Cypress and throughout Orange County get in touch with an independent personal injury attorney. The attorney you're connected with handles the legal work, not LawProactive.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim after an accident in California?
items.answer: In most personal injury cases, California law gives you two years from the date of the injury to file a claim. If a government entity was involved, the window can be much shorter, sometimes just six months, so it's worth checking your situation promptly.

items.question: Where do crashes tend to happen in Cypress?
items.answer: Public records show that Valley View Street, Walker Street, Ball Road, and Lincoln Avenue have the highest recorded collision counts in Cypress, with reported crashes tending to cluster on Wednesday afternoons between 2 and 4 p.m. These are simply neutral counts from public records, not a judgment about any particular road.

items.question: What if I was partly at fault for the accident?
items.answer: California's pure comparative fault rule means you can still pursue compensation even if you share some responsibility for the accident. Your recovery would be reduced by your percentage of fault, but it isn't automatically barred, so it's worth having your situation reviewed.
